summary:
The emerging infrastructure for autonomous artificial intelligence agents to spend money online may be developing faster than the agents themselves. A new analysis by blockchain intelligence company TRM Labs found that only a fraction of payments flowing through x402, one of the most prominent protocols designed for machine-to-machine commerce, can be attributed to autonomous AI […]
The post Agentic Payments Are Growing, but Most x402 Payments Aren’t From AI Agents appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: A new analysis by TRM Labs reveals that while machine-to-machine commerce infrastructure is expanding rapidly, only a small fraction of transactions passing through the x402 payment protocol actually originate from autonomous AI agents. The findings suggest that the technology for machine spending is currently outpacing the actual adoption and deployment of AI agents in the digital economy.
